scale_up_blockers: Upstream multi-utterance insight grouping merges disparate topics (e.g. transport safety merged with road cracks in INS_0127; hospital bribery merged with doctor absence in INS_0050).
Upstream topic classification errors (e.g. school toilets misclassified as teacher shortage; CIB worksite transparency misclassified as wage delays) break downstream semantic alignment chains.
Automatic disambiguation and semantic-chain validation filters must be added before full-corpus execution.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Citizens in Bhagalpur report scheduled feeder maintenance shutdown (Barari feeder) and frequent unannounced power cuts causing intermittent outages.
per_case_results.taxonomy_issue: Frequent Power Outages, Low Voltage & Burnt Transformers
per_case_results.external_definition: Proportion of population with access to electricity (percentage of households with an electricity connection). Custodian: World Bank / WHO.
per_case_results.mapping_justification: SDG 7.1.1 measures binary household electrification access. GV evidence provides qualitative operational context regarding grid reliability and load-shedding frequency, contrasting with static connection metrics.
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Local incident reports of feeder downtime, qualitative accounts of supply intermittency in Bhagalpur.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: Total proportion of population with electrical connection, district electrification rate, official meter counts.
per_case_results.audit_notes: Utterance 01-09983-02 is a scheduled feeder maintenance announcement; 02-17143-01 is a citizen outage report. Merging them into 'burnt transformers' is partially consistent; alignment is valid as contextual operational data via 02-17143-01.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Citizens in Jamui report absence of medical doctors on duty at Agera Primary Health Centre (PHC) and illegal charges demanded at Sadar Hospital.
per_case_results.external_definition: Health worker density and distribution (physicians, nursing and midwifery personnel per 10,000 population). Custodian: WHO.
per_case_results.mapping_justification: SDG 3.c.1 tracks macro health worker density from administrative payrolls. GV captures localized facility-level physical absence where sanctioned doctors are absent from assigned rural health posts.
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Eyewitness reports of doctor absence at Agera PHC on duty days, citizen grievance timestamps.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: District health worker density per 10,000 population, formal payroll attendance records, state workforce totals.
per_case_results.audit_notes: Utterance 01-05273-03 firmly supports doctor absence at Agera PHC. Utterance 01-05235-02 is about bribery/charging at Sadar hospital. Translation of 01-05273-03 included unstated extrapolation ('patients unable to receive treatment'). Relationship adjusted from narrower_concept to contextual_relationship.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Citizens in Gaya report newly constructed rural road cracking and developing severe structural fissures within 2-3 months of construction.
per_case_results.external_definition: Proportion of the rural population who live within 2 km of an all-season road (Rural Access Index). Custodian: World Bank / UNECE.
per_case_results.mapping_justification: SDG 9.1.1 measures spatial proximity (2 km buffer) to all-season roads. GV captures premature structural degradation and asphalt cracking within 90 days that compromise nominal all-weather motorability.
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Post-commissioning road degradation reports, localized construction quality complaints in Gaya.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: Spatial buffer population percentage (RAI denominator), total road network length in km.
per_case_results.audit_notes: Grounding is fully supported by 02-17203-01 (road cracked in 2-3 months). Utterance 01-08604-01 concerns bus driver verification and GPS safety rather than physical road infrastructure. Validated with caveat based on 02-17203-01.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Citizens in Barkakala village, Hazaribagh report Fair Price Shop dealer deducting 2 kg rice per ration card from entitled monthly quota despite formal complaints.
per_case_results.external_definition: Statutory entitlement of 5 kg foodgrains per person per month for priority households at subsidized prices under NFSA 2013.
per_case_results.mapping_justification: NFSA statutory guidelines mandate 5 kg grain per person per month. Dealer under-weighing (2 kg/card deduction) is a direct micro-level operational failure of statutory entitlement delivery at the point of distribution.
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Specific Fair Price Shop dealer under-weighing reports (2 kg cut), village-level distribution grievance documentation.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: District total grain lifting percentage, state food balance sheet, aggregate NFSA compliance rate.
per_case_results.audit_notes: Perfect semantic chain. Utterance text, taxonomy issue, structured insight, statutory definition, and narrower_concept relationship align with complete precision.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Panchayat representatives in Bihar report inspection of MGNREGA worksites revealing absence of mandatory Citizen Information Boards (CIB).
per_case_results.taxonomy_issue: MGNREGA Wage Delays, Job Cards & Work Allotment
per_case_results.external_definition: Mandatory proactive public disclosure through Citizen Information Boards at every worksite detailing estimates, sanctions, and labor muster.
per_case_results.mapping_justification: The external mapping targets worksite transparency (CIB installation), which matches the utterance, but contradicts the assigned taxonomy issue ('Wage Delays, Job Cards & Work Allotment').
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Worksite transparency inspection findings, missing information board reports.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: Wage delay rates, job card issuance statistics, person-days generated.
per_case_results.audit_notes: REJECTED: Severe semantic chain break. The utterance describes worksite transparency inspection, but was misclassified by upstream classifier into 'Wage Delays & Job Cards'. Mapping to CIB rules fits the utterance but violates the taxonomy issue.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Smallholder farmers in Munger report severe deficit of promised agricultural electricity and canal/borewell water supply during peak crop season.
per_case_results.external_definition: Net Irrigated Area by Source (Canals, Tubewells, Wells, Tanks) in hectares recorded in District Census Handbooks.
per_case_results.mapping_justification: Census Village Directory records physical asset presence (canals, tubewells) and net irrigated area. GV provides dynamic operational testimony regarding seasonal water non-delivery and pump energization deficits.
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Farmer accounts of seasonal irrigation deficits, pump energization bottlenecks in Munger.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: Net irrigated area in hectares, aquifer depth (m bgl), volumetric canal flow rates.
per_case_results.audit_notes: Solid semantic chain. Clear distinction between static census infrastructure existence and dynamic seasonal irrigation failure.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Community members in Madhubani report primary schools staffed by untrained Shiksha Mitra contract teachers unable to deliver quality foundational education.
per_case_results.external_definition: Proportion of teachers with the minimum required qualifications, by education level (percentage receiving organized pedagogical training). Custodian: UNESCO-UIS.
per_case_results.mapping_justification: SDG 4.c.1 tracks macro proportions of qualified teachers. GV captures community ground perspectives regarding the persistence of untrained contract teachers in local primary schools.
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Community testimony on untrained contract teacher deployment, parent observations on teaching quality.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: Statewide percentage of certified teachers under RTE norms, administrative UDISE+ pupil-teacher ratios.
per_case_results.audit_notes: Taxonomy issue label emphasizes 'Shortage & Absenteeism', while evidence discusses teacher qualification/training. Relationship adjusted to contextual_relationship. Validated with caveat.

per_case_results.gv_evidence_summary: Citizens in Sonepur, Saran report mandatory Aadhaar linkage enforcement by local offices causing administrative exclusion in violation of Supreme Court guidelines.

per_case_results.external_definition: Proportion of population covered by social protection floors/systems. Custodian: ILO.

per_case_results.gv_can_support: Citizen reports of administrative non-compliance and documentation barriers in Sonepur, Saran.
per_case_results.gv_cannot_support: State social protection coverage rate, UIDAI Aadhaar saturation percentage, bank DBT authentication success rates.

per_case_results.mapping_justification: The external mapping targets school toilets (SDG 4.a.1), which matches the utterance text, but completely contradicts the assigned taxonomy issue ('Teacher Shortage & Teacher Absenteeism').
per_case_results.gv_can_support: Facility-level toilet non-functionality, handpump breakdown reports in Kharagpur.
